notes.title: 2021/5/6 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone. [/h1]
[h2]Thanks for playing this game![/h2]
[b] I have changed some content in this update.  In this update, I added some clues, and I found that there are too few clues in some scenes.  So some text descriptions have been added to make it easier to find.  And added some scene lighting to make some key scenes brighter.  [/b]
[h3]Thank you very much for your support. I will work harder to make works that satisfy everyone.[/h3]
